message: Namaste! Mera naam VoiceBot hai. Main aapki kaise help kar sakta hoon? / Meeru ela untaro?
Sure! Meeku software demo schedule chestanu. Aapko kab convenient hai? Monday ya Tuesday? / Aapko kaunsa time suit karega?
मैं हूं जियान मेरा गला है भोसरी ला
Bahut accha! Aapka naam sunke khushi hui. Aap kya help chahte hain? / Meeru cheppindi vinataniki santhosham aindi!
